title: Horsie's cursed Head
description: I created this mod after having a random thought on the toilet: what if a sword had a horse’s head? So… here it is.
body:
Ever wondered what life would be like if swords had horse heads? Probably not—but now you don’t have to.
Horsie Mod brings you a chaotic mix of questionable ideas and glorious nonsense straight into Minecraft.

Features 🐴⚔️

The Horsie Sword – A majestic (and slightly cursed) blade with a horse’s head.

The Horsie Head – Trade 1 Diamond Sword with a Villager to get one.

The Horsooka – Collect 2 Horsie Heads, 3 Horsie Hearts, and one Steel Pipe to craft this… terrifying invention.

Premise Structures – Random structures scattered around the world containing chests with items for Horsie Slicer trades.

Icon Block – Functions as both a decorative block and the job block for the Horsie Slicer.

Cat? Block – Nobody knows why. Don’t ask.

New Mobs

Piggi Guy 🐷

Looong Snail 🐌 (yes, it’s really long)

And more surprises waiting to be discovered.

Throwable Rock – Sometimes you just need to throw a rock.

Other little secrets – Because chaos is best served with mystery.
